$comment: Data contract for projects/<slug>/findings.json. Kept stable on purpose so a future WordPress front end can render it without changing the research pipeline.

project.name: string
project.project_type: new construction | addition | plan change | initial consult | other
project.description: one to three sentences of project context

jurisdiction.notes: string, e.g. why jurisdiction was ambiguous if it was

findings.id: string, stable slug for this finding
findings.category: zoning | building | fire_life_safety | accessibility | health_food_service | plumbing | electrical_mechanical | other
findings.question: the question as asked or as inferred
findings.source_quote: the line(s) in the source document that triggered this finding, or null if purely inferred

applicable_codes.adopted_by: e.g. Maricopa County Environmental Services, by reference

findings.rule_in_plain_language: string, applied to this project's specifics
findings.verification_note: standing note on what still needs architect/engineer/AHJ sign-off
